programme.title: Kickboxer - A Retaliação
programme.desc: Um ano após os acontecimentos de “Kickboxer - A Vingança”, Kurt Sloan jura nunca voltar à Tailândia. Mas acaba por ser forçado a regressar ao ser dopado e atirado para uma prisão. Para recuperar a liberdade, terá de enfrentar Mongkut, um verdadeiro gigante de 200kg e mais de dois metros de altura.

programme.title: Fim De Turno
programme.desc: Na zona de South Central em Los Angeles, os polícias Brian Taylor e Mike Zavala estabelecem uma poderosa amizade para garantir que regressam sempre ambos a casa no ´Fim do Turno´. Mas quando uma operação dá para o torto, tornam-se alvos a abater por um dos mais violentos carteis da região.

programme.title: Headhunters - Caçadores De Cabeças
programme.desc: De dia, Roger Brown é um caçador de talentos sem rival no mundo empresarial mas de noite é um ladrão de arte prolífero, com olho para grandes antiguidades. É nessa sua segunda vida que ele resolve ariscar tudo ao tentar roubar uma valiosa pintura a um antigo mercenário...

programme.title: O Hóspede
programme.desc: David é um soldado que se apresenta à família Peterson como amigo próximo do seu filho, que morreu em combate. Só que após acolher o jovem em casa, o casal começa a aperceber-se que há uma série de mortes que começam a assombrar a cidade, e que parecem estar todas ligadas à sua presença.

programme.title: Auggie
programme.desc: Forçado a uma reforma antecipada, Felix Greystone apaixona-se por uma jovem em realidade virtual, esquecendo a sua relação com a sua mulher e filha.

programme.title: Agora ou Nunca
programme.desc: Após uma longa relação, Eva e Alex decidem casar na povoação de Inglaterra em que se apaixonaram. Mas os controladores de tráfego aéreo fazem greve por tempo indeterminado, e o noivo e alguns convidados vão ter de ultrapassar os azares e os obstáculos mais desvairados para chegarem a tempo à boda.

programme.title: Bem-Vindo A Acapulco
programme.desc: Matt Booth, um designer de jogos de vídeo, vai parar a Acapulco após uma noite de bebedeira e tem de enfrentar não só criminosos de alta estirpe e assassinos implacáveis como a própria Policia Federal, todos em busca de um pacote misterioso que ele teria, alegadamente, feito passar na alfandega.

programme.title: Mulher De Ouro
programme.desc: Maria Altmann, uma octogenária judia austríaca refugiada nos EUA, não se vai deter perante nada para recuperar os bens da sua família apreendidos pelos nazis, entre eles um famoso quadro de Gustav Klimt, missão em que será ajudada por um corajoso mas inexperiente advogado.

programme.title: Zona Proibida
programme.desc: John Wall é uma alma perdida que vagueia pela cidade de Nova Iorque e que acaba por ter uma ligação especial com duas jovens com quem passa o aniversário, refletindo sobre os percursos pelos quais as suas vida autodestrutivas os levaram.

programme.title: Kursk
programme.desc: A 12 de agosto do ano 2000, o submarino russo Kursk afundou-se no Mar de Barents, num desastre foi muito agravado por negligência governamental. Enquanto os marinheiros lutam pela sobrevivência debaixo de água, as suas famílias esbarram em obstáculos políticos e na impossibilidade de salvá-los.

programme.title: Réplicas
programme.desc: William Foster é um neurocientista genial cuja mulher e os três filhos morrem num acidente de carro. Secretamente, ele vai tentar clonar os seus corpos criando réplicas, mas vai ter de fazer uma escolha radical: ele só consegue trazer três dos seus quatro familiares de volta à vida.

programme.title: Backtrace Rasto de Violência
programme.desc: Após ficar ferido gravemente durante um assalto, MacDonald perde a memória e é colocado na ala psiquiátrica de uma prisão de alta segurança. Sete anos passados, é contactado por outro prisioneiro que lhe oferece ajuda para fugir da prisão…

programme.title: Quo Vadis
programme.desc: No ano 64 d.C., Marcus Vinicius, um comandante romano, apaixona-se por Lygia, uma devota escrava cristã, e começa a questionar a liderança tirânica do despótico imperador Nero.

programme.title: Um Homem Perigoso
programme.desc: Horas após sair da cadeia, onde esteve seis anos preso por um crime que não cometeu, Shane Daniels testemunha o assassinato de um polícia pela máfia chinesa, e vê-se na obrigação de ajudar uma menina e o seu tio cobrando favores antigos à máfia russa.

programme.title: Os Dias Do Fim
programme.desc: Na viragem do século, Satanás visita Nova Iorque em busca de uma noiva e o único que o poderá deter é um ex-polícia que agora gere uma empresa de segurança de elite.

programme.title: Os Ingleses Estão A Chegar
programme.desc: Harriet e Peter Fox são um casal de vigaristas ingleses que, após perderem uma grande soma ao póquer e ficarem a dever dinheiro a uma gangster psicótica, fogem para Los Angeles onde acabam por criar um elaborado plano para roubar um anel à rica ex-mulher de Peter.

programme.title: Relações Criminosas
programme.desc: Enquanto investiga uma série de assassinatos, um detetive de homicídios torna-se o principal suspeito quando o FBI descobre que ele tem relações diretas com todas as vítimas.

programme.title: Força Maior
programme.desc: Uma família sueca goza umas férias num resort dos Alpes Franceses, mas uma avalanche vai provocar o caos durante o almoço num restaurante na montanha, e as reações instintivas do casal vão causar uma fissura que pode provocar o fim da relação.

programme.title: Guerreiro Ciborg
programme.desc: Num futuro devastado por um desastre nuclear, o mundo é controlado por guerreiros ciborgues, só que um deles, Gabriel, tem por missão eliminar todos os outros e trazer a paz. Para o ajudar nessa missão ele treina uma jovem guerreira com incríveis habilidades de luta e sede de vingança.

programme.title: Salvar O Natal
programme.desc: Danny é um miúdo que tenta provar a existência do Pai Natal quando a irmã diz que já não acredita nele. Agora, com o auxílio dos seus melhores amigos e recorrendo a tecnologia de ponta que eles próprios fabricaram, vai partir numa jornada para encontrar a verdade sobre o velhinho da barba branca.

Porto, 1618. A Inquisição continua a perseguir os judeus portugueses, enviando o Visitador Sebastião de Noronha para a cidade do Porto. Com a família e a sua comunidade em perigo, António Álvares, decide delinear um plano de fuga.

programme.title: A Balada De Adam Henry
programme.desc: Fiona Maye é uma juíza que tem de julgar o caso de um adolescente de 17 anos com leucemia que é Testemunha de Jeová e se recusa, por motivos religiosos, a receber uma transfusão de sangue que o poderá ajudar a salvar a vida.

programme.title: Intriga Internacional
programme.desc: Roger O. Thornhill é um executivo publicitário que é confundido com um agente federal por um grupo de espiões. O equívoco dá lugar a uma série de mal-entendidos, incluindo a acusação de homicídio, tentativas de rapto e perseguições, quer por parte dos espiões, quer por parte do governo.

programme.title: Golpe De Amor
programme.desc: Quando Richard percebe que a sua empresa foi vendida a um empresário fraudulento e que os fundos de pensões de todos os funcionários desapareceram, decide juntar-se à ex-mulher para recuperar o dinheiro, numa aventura pela Europa que envolve perseguições loucas e roubo de joias.

programme.title: Reprisal - Contra-Ataque
programme.desc: Jacob testemunha um assalto ao banco onde trabalha e decide tentar apanhar o criminoso com a ajuda de um polícia reformado. Só que o assaltante contra-ataca de forma violenta, rapta a família do bancário e está preparado para levar a situação até ao limite.

programme.title: O Som Do Trovão
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo, viajar no tempo torna-se possível e os aventureiros ricos podem participar em safaris na pré-história onde podem caçar dinossauros. Só que um único erro no passado pode provocar consequências devastadoras no presente e no futuro.

programme.title: Bowfinger - O Sem Vergonha
programme.desc: Bobby Bowfinger, produtor de filmes, há anos que tenta conseguir um êxito de bilheteira. O seu próximo filme terá tudo o que um grande sucesso precisa: ação, alienígenas, uma bela jovem e Kit Ramsey, a maior estrela de Hollywood. Só há um senão: o próprio Kit não sabe que foi escolhido para o papel.

programme.title: Eu, Alex Cross
programme.desc: Alex Cross é um detetive de homicídios de Detroit que vai ser levado a todos os limites físicos e morais qusndo tem de lidar com um assassino contratado que se especializa em dor e tortura.

programme.title: Resposta Armada
programme.desc: Uma equipa de agentes altamente treinada e liderada por Isaac vê-se encurralada num complexo militar isolado e começa a ser alvo de fenómenos estranhos à medida que tenta descobrir quem matou a equipa anterior que ela lá foi resgatar.

programme.title: Hush - Malévolo
programme.desc: Os irmãos Jackson e Angela Sayers gerem um falso negócio de caça-fantasmas e enganam idosos numa pequena cidade. Mas quando são contratados por um senhor para analisar um antigo orfanato, descobrem que algo muito real assombra a casa isolada.

programme.title: A Presença Maligna
programme.desc: Uma médica do exército britânico volta da guerra e pensa que sofre de stress pós-traumático quando o que descobre é que afinal existe um espírito maligno assustador que ameaça transformar por completo a sua vida.

programme.title: Wagner - Das Rheingold
programme.desc: Das Rheingold is the prologue to Richard Wagner's Ring Cycle. This rendition (2003) features the Staatsoper Stuttgart under the baton of conductor Lothar Zagrosek. Tonight’s soloists are Wolfgang Probst, Motti Kastón, Bernhard Schneider, Robert Künzli, Esa Ruuttunen, Eberhard Francesco Lorenz and Roland Bracht.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: During the years when Bach was in the service of the courts of Prince Leopold in Köthen, he had his own orchestra and was contracted to compose a great deal of instrumental music. This gave him an opportunity to try new techniques and to develop his own instrumental style. The six Brandenburg Concertos belongs to these masterpieces which he composed for a small ensemble .

programme.title: Israel Philharmonic Orchestra: Coming Home
programme.desc: On December 24, 2011, one of the world’s most renowned classical orchestras, the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra, celebrated the 75th anniversary of its founding. The film portrays the orchestra and its eventful history against the backdrop of Israel and the holocaust.

programme.title: Dvorák - Violin Concerto in A minor, Op. 53
programme.desc: For the 2016 edition of the Waldbühne, the Georgian violinist Lisa Batiashvili and the Québécois conductor Yannick Nézet-Séguin join the Berliner Philharmoniker for a beautiful concert. They present an all Czech program!

programme.title: Telemann - Jesus liegt in letzten Zügen, TWV 1:983
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 4
programme.desc: Discover the soloist Heidrun Holtmann as she performs Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 1, KV 37 and Piano Concerto No. 4, KV 41, accompanied by the Orchestra della Radiotelevisione della Svizzera. Conducted by Marc Andreae, the performance took place at the historic Teatro Bibiena in Mantua.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Overture-Fantasy Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Overture-Fantasy “Romeo and Juliet”. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Tchaikovsky based his composition on Shakespeare’s famous play “Romeo and Juliet”.

programme.title: Organ works by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: German organist Ullrich Böhme performs various organ works by J. S. Bach at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in this concert recording from 2000. St. Thomas Church is associated with several composers, including Felix Mendelssohn and Richard Wagner, but most especially with J. S. Bach, who was ‘Thomaskantor’ from 1723 until his death in 1750.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Diepenbrock, Fauré a. o.
programme.desc: Tenor Zhuohan Sun (China, 1993) and pianist Sara Pavlovic (Serbia, 1996) perform ‘Wanderlied’ from Robert Schumann’s Kerner-Lieder, Op. 35; ‘Der Abend kommt gezogen’ from Alphons Diepenbrock’s Drie ballades, Op. 1; Gabriel Fauré’s Prison, Op. 83, No. 1; ‘Ganymed’ from Hugo Wolf’s Goethe-Lieder; Franz Schubert’s Nacht und Träume, D. 827; Zaiyi Lu’s The bridge in my homeland; ‘Mit Myrten und Rosen’ from Schumann’s Liederkreis, Op.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 31, Op. 110
programme.desc: Can we get into Beethoven’s creative mind, especially in the last phase of his life, when he was coping with severe hearing loss? Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Solos for Clarinet, Part I
programme.desc: The great clarinettist Paolo Beltramini plays a program of solo pieces for clarinet on Stingray Brava. In this broadcast, Beltramini performs C.P.E. Bach’s Solfeggietto, Béla Kovàc’s Hommage à Paganini, and Igor Stravinsky’s Three Pieces for Clarinet Solo. Paolo Beltramini is the only Italian clarinettist to have won first prize at the prestigious Prague Spring International Clarinet Competition (1996).

programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 9, Op. 95
programme.desc: Latvian conductor Andris Nelsons leads the Gewandhausorchester Leipzig in a performance of Antonín Dvorák’s Symphony No. 9 in E Minor, Op. 95, ‘From the New World’. Dvorák wrote this famous symphony in 1893, during his three-year term as Director of the National Conservatory of Music in New York. The Conservatory had hired the nationalist composer to create a new, national style of art music for the United States.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 6 and 15
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Albéniz - Iberia Book 1 And 2
programme.desc: Star pianist Daniel Barenboim performs the first and second books of Isaac Albéniz’s piano suite Iberia. Composed between 1905 and 1908, Iberia is in four books of three pieces each. This masterpiece paints twelve musical portraits of Spanish regions, traditions, and atmospheres. This performance was recorded at the Teatro Colón in Buenos Aires, Argentina, on August 19, 2000.

programme.title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program.

programme.title: Mendelssohn - Violin Concerto, Op. 64
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in the 2016 edition of the Europakonzert. This time, it takes place at the beautiful Baroque church of Røros, a Norwegian mining town whose intact picturesque old town makes it a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The talented Norwegian violinist Vilde Frang is the star soloist in Mendelssohn’s songful Violin Concerto, Op. 64, which she plays with warmth, elegance and effortless virtuosity.

programme.title: Anastasia
programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story. Created by acclaimed choreographer Bengt Jörgen, the ballet is set to an original score for orchestra by Russian composer Ivan Barbotin.

programme.title: Works for violin and piano: Mozart, Beethoven a.o.
programme.desc: On the occasion of International Women’s Day, Italian violinist Laura Marzadori and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti performed a wonderful concert at Teatro Sociale di Camogli, Italy. On the program are Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sonata No. 18 in G major, K. 301; Ludwig van Beethoven’s Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op.

programme.title: Music by Beethoven
programme.desc: Three of classical music's most beloved stars gather for a concert devoted entirely to Beethoven's music, recorded in 1995 at the Berliner Philharmonie by Barrie Gavin. Daniel Barenboim (piano), Yo-Yo Ma (cello) and Itzhak Perlman (violin) perform the Triple Concerto, op. 56 and the Fantaisie chorale, op. 80.

programme.title: Bach - The Well-Tempered Clavier No. 24
programme.desc: In 1722, when Johann Sebastian Bach lived in Köthen, Germany, he published a book of preludes and fugues in all 24 major and minor keys. This collection became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book One, BWV 846–869. About two decades later, Bach compiled a second book in Leipzig, which became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book Two, BWV 870-893.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Excerpts from Romeo And Julia, Op. 64
programme.desc: The beautiful Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg formed the background for the 1996 edition of the annual Europakonzert of the Berliner Philharmoniker. In honour of the Russian hosts, the concert opened with highlights from Prokofiev's 'Romeo and Juliet', followed by the Cavatina from Rachmaninoff's opera 'Aleko'.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Iolanta
programme.desc: ‘Iolanta’ and ‘Perséphone’ – A double bill consisting of two stage works that “represent an ideal of beauty, poetry and hope” forms this new production by Peter Sellars in Madrid from the Teatro Real from 2012. In both works, the progression from darkness to light acts as an initiation rite that completely transforms the existential attitude of the leading characters.

programme.title: Bach - Violin Sonata No. 3 (BWV 1005)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging piece. This performance was recorded at St.

programme.title: Strauss - Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Violinist Daniel Rowland, violist Rachel Roberts, cellist Julian Arp, and pianist Diana Ketler perform Richard Strauss’s Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13, as part of the Stiftfestival 2016 in the Dutch village of Weerselo. In his early years, Strauss tried to compose different types of chamber music works, including a piano quartet.

programme.title: Beethoven - Fidelio, Op. 72
programme.desc: Fidelio (originally titled 'Leonore, oder Der Triumph der ehelichen Liebe,' which translates to 'Leonore, or the Triumph of Marital Love'), Op. 72, is Ludwig van Beethoven's only opera. This 2018 opera film from the Swiss Theater St. Gallen is based on Jan Schmidt-Garre's highly acclaimed stage production of Beethoven's Fidelio. Otto Tausk conducts the Sinfonieorchester and choir of St.

programme.title: A Night in Vienna
programme.desc: A Night in Vienna recreates the magical atmosphere of 19th century Viennese ballrooms. In the breathtaking surroundings of Vienna's Hofburg Palace, the Wiener Akademie period orchestra, conducted by Alfred Eschwe, plays some of the Strauss family's and Joseph Lanner's favorite pieces, including 'The Beautiful Blue Danube', 'Tritsch-Tratsch-Polka', and the 'Radetzky March'.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes at the Zurich Opera House
programme.desc: The Zurich Opera House is one of the most renowned in Europe. Fifteen premieres are staged here every year - a significant achievement, when one considers just how much work goes into each individual production.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 1, Op. 68
programme.desc: For over two decades, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its creation on May 1 with the annual Europakonzert, which in 2010 was held in Oxford. Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra performed a program including Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 1.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Fauré, Wolf a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Alisa Fedorenko (Russia, 1999) and pianist Evgenii Sergeev (Russia, 1986) perform ‘Mandoline’ and ‘À Clymène’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Cinq melodies “de Venise”, Op. 58; ‘Lied der Delphine’ from Franz Schubert’s Zwei Szenen aus dem Schauspiel ‘Lacrimas’, D. 857; ‘Son’ (A dream) from Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Six Romances, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 19
programme.desc: From the Barockschloss in Rammenau the Gewandhaus-Quartett plays Mozart’s String Quartet No. 19 in C-major, KV. 465. This work is nicknamed 'Dissonance' due to its unusual slow introduction with dissonant notes before the harmony resolving in the key of C-major, starting the bright Allegro section.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 4 in D major, K. 218. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist.

programme.title: Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. Each piece is in two parts: a prelude followed by a fugue. The composer was doubtlessly inspired by J. S.

programme.title: Telemann - Der am Ölberg zagende Jesus, TWV 1: 364
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Concerto for Orchestra
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Bela Bartok’s ‘Concerto for Orchestra’ is discussed.

programme.title: Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2, 'Resurrection'
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, ‘Resurrection’. Soprano Christiane Karg and alto Claudia Huckle are the soloists. Written between 1888 and 1894, this five-movement symphony is scored for a large orchestra, chorus, and soprano and alto soloists.

programme.title: Monteverdi - Madrigals, Book III
programme.desc: Italian composer Claudio Monteverdi (1567-1643) composed nine books of madrigals in half a century, which helped transform the genre from the polyphonic, a cappella madrigals of the late Renaissance to the ‘concertato’ madrigals of the early Baroque, shifting the style’s focus to the ability of music to express emotions contained in a text.

programme.title: England, my England - II
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht was all about 'England, my England'. In line with this theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer on an intriguing journey through the England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 15, Op. 132
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 3
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major, K. 216. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist.

programme.title: Naples, City of Keyboards - Alessandro Scarlatti
programme.desc: At the age of 24, following his successes in Rome, Alessandro Scarlatti was appointed royal Kapellmeister in Naples, in 1684. There he had to deal with jealousy and contempt from those involved in the local music scene. Scarlatti came up with the best possible answer to this harassment by enjoying a brilliant career lasting nearly thirty years and producing a phenomenal oeuvre in the process.

programme.title: Cleveland Orchestra - Centennial Celebration
programme.desc: For the Anniversary Gala, Cleveland Orchestra Music Director Franz Welser-Möst led a program featuring pianist Lang Lang as soloist. The program offered works touching on more than a century of Viennese musical traditions with Lang Lang performing Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 24. The pianist made his Cleveland Orchestra debut in 2000 at Blossom Music Center and most recently performed with the Orchestra in 2014 at Severance Hall.

programme.title: Penderecki - Symphony No. 7: 7 Gates of Jerusalem
programme.desc: The 2017 Prague Spring festival is brought to a powerful close as Krzysztof Penderecki conducts the Prague Radio Symphony Orchestra and Slovak Philharmonic Choir in a performance of his monumental seventh symphony 'Seven Gates of Jerusalem'. This work bears witness to an introspective thought about faith, written in honour of the city of Jerusalem, for soloists, choir and orchestra, with libretto taken from Old Testament.

programme.title: Tales of Two Cities: Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. Its musical director is Jeanne Lamon. Together with the Trio Arabica they celebrate the music and culture in the eighteenth century.

programme.title: Franck - Sonata for violin and piano
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and violinist Maxim Vengerov perform César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Music of Naples
programme.desc: Throughout the centuries, the Italian city of Naples has proved to have a remarkably favorable climate for artistic innovation. The presence of the royal or vice royal courts, the practice of music in churches, fraternities, and charitable institutions, financial support from well-to-do citizens, and the popularity of song and dance in public life made for an extraordinarily diverse musical landscape.

programme.title: Beethoven - Violin Concerto, Op. 61
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Ludwig van Beethoven’s Violin Concerto in D major, Op. 61. Leading violinist Grimal is the soloist.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz' Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. This performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Richard Danielpour (*1956) is one of the most beloved American composers of his generation due to his frequent referencing of and connection with the past, being inspired by American icons such as Aaron Copland, Samuel Barber and Leonard Bernstein. His lush musical language is often infused with swingy jazz rhythms just as is the music of Copland and Bernstein.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Donizetti – L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: With Rolando Villazón directing and playing the title role, the world rushed for tickets to the Baden-Baden 2012 Pentecost-holiday opera. Following his directorial debut in 2011 (Werther, Lyon) the Mexican tenor went a step further, staging Gaetano Donizetti’s L’elisir d’amore and directing himself in the role of Nemorino.

programme.title: Festive Mozart Concert from Salzburg
programme.desc: This performance was recorded during Mozart Week on January 27, 2006 in Salzburg, Austria, at the Großes Festspielhaus (Large Festival House) in celebration of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's 250th birthday. Under conductor Riccardo Muti, it features Thomas Hampson (baritone), Mitsuko Uchida (piano), Gidon Kremer (violin), Yuri Bashmet (viola), Wiener Singverein, and Wiener Philharmoniker. Pieces include Piano Concerto No.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

O filme celebra os 700 anos da carta do foral atribuída pelo Rei D. Dinis, explorando mitos e a cultura local. .

programme.title: Minha Terra Minha Gente

programme.title: Os Novos Presidentes: Silves
programme.desc: O Conta Lá apresenta com tempo e detalhe os novos presidentes de câmara. Descubra quem vai liderar o seu concelho, que sonhos, projetos e que ideias que tem para a sua terra.

programme.title: Feira Semanal: Vila Real
programme.desc: Na nobre e altaneira Vila Real, terra de serra e vales, a Feira é refúgio, ritual e resistência. Aqui, a feira sobe a encosta com a mesma força com que desce o nevoeiro das serras. Às sextas-feiras, a cidade reencontra-se entre tendas cheias de hortícolas, queijo da serra, roupas, músicas em forma de cd´s e histórias contadas ao ritmo do tempo.

programme.title: A Letra: Samuel Uria - 'Um Adeus Português'
programme.desc: Num formato intimista de 11 minutos, o programa acompanha Margarida Pinto Correia em conversas próximas com músicos, centradas no significado das letras e no processo criativo por trás das canções.A canção “Um Adeus Português”, de Samuel Úria, integra o álbum 2000 A.D. (2024) e nasce de uma relação direta com a tradição literária portuguesa.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T6 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Drew lança-se a uma pilha de antiguidades. Entretanto, entra numa loja com tanto estilo como o seu vaidoso dono.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T6 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Drew visita uma velha casa senhorial em Gales e encontra um maravilhoso tesouro esquecido no sótão. Em Norfolk, experimenta alguma arte urbana impressionante.

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters T6 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: A cabana isolada de uma família em Mount Vernon não tem cozinha, casa de banho e eletricidade. Conseguirá a equipa melhorar a habitabilidade e preservar o seu charme rústico?

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters T6 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Durante os últimos 30 anos, uma família tem sido proprietária de uma monstruosidade no Lago Cobbosseecontee. Chase e a equipa concordam em salvar esta família.

programme.title: Restauradores Ao Resgate T11 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A equipa aceita um convite para recuperar uma antiga mansão centenária em Jamestown, Nova Iorque. Recolhem balaústres e belos vitrais.

programme.title: Restauradores Ao Resgate T11 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A equipa regressa a Jamestown em busca de artigos numa casa que foi alargada para criar a Mansão dos Moose. Descobrem lâmpadas de néon e telhas com ornamentos.

programme.title: Restauradores De Casas De Campo: A Construir Em Itália T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Chase Morrill leva a família e a equipa para as profundezas do campo italiano à procura do próximo grande projeto de renovação.

programme.title: Restauradores De Casas De Campo: A Construir Em Itália T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A família Morrill e a equipa trabalham com os locais desde a demolição até ao primeiro grande projeto: uma casa de banho.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T4 - Ep. 20
programme.desc: O Dr. Pinball, especialista em jogos de árcade, restaura um raro jogo de basquetebol americano dos anos 40. O artista, Nick, aplica reboco e tinta a um enorme touro vintage.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T5 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: O estofador, Craig, tenta salvar dois sofás usados na série televisiva Dr. Who. O ferreiro, Nev, transforma dois candeeiros de rua em candeeiros de referência para a casa.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Rick ressuscita o Monster Red para apanhar pepitas com a ajuda de Freddy Dodge e Tony constrói uma enorme escavadora. Dustin regressa a Haines depois de um deslizamento devastador.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Tony põe a vista numa monstruosa escavadora de 3,5 milhões de USD. Dave procura uma concessão com a nova máquina de prospeção Mad Max. Rick testa um método pioneiro de perfuração.

O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. programme.title: Lucky Chops - Live at BIRD
programme.desc: The NYC band Lucky Chops rose to fame when a video of their performance at a subway station went viral on YouTube in 2015. Since then, the energetic quintet has been entertaining audiences all over the world. The band was formed in 2006, when trumpeter Joshua Gawel, saxophonist Daro Behroozi, trombonist Josh Holcomb, tubist Raphael Buyo, and drummer Charles Sams, met during their education at Fiorello H.

programme.title: Rebirth: Richard Lemz
programme.desc: Amsterdam, February 6th, 2018 - The short documentary Rebirth in The Amsterdam Red Light District illustrates how brutal Richard Lems' life as an addict was and his struggle to unshackle himself from the shame. Filled with fierce, freighting, and sad moments, Richard relives his stabbing, stay in jail, drug test, and drug use.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Klezmer to Piazzolla
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences.

programme.title: Bayerischer Hof Night Club: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Trio
programme.desc: The Cuban pianist, composer and bandleader Gonzalo Rubalcaba is a star name on today's international jazz scene. Technically dazzling and brilliantly creative, Rubalcaba generates infectious excitement with his music. He says he uses jazz as a reference, but takes in the Cuban and African background which was itself an important influence on jazz musicians in the US.

programme.title: Taking It Back And Nobody
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: Milonga Noctiva
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Voyage
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: November Music: R. Frerichs/H. Alizadeh/Cello8ctet
programme.desc: The November Music festival in ‘s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands is the ultimate event for experiencing a broad range of music. It features a wonderful variety of contemporary and experimental pop, sound art, non-Western music, jazz and free improvisation.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Jeroen van Vliet Moon Trio
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning’. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms.

programme.title: Rita Reys And The Pim Jacobs Trio at North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: VIVA!
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. “Viva” is a perfect mixture of various instruments and musicians from all over the world.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Charles Lloyd Quartet live in Brussels
programme.desc: Since 1960, the legendary saxophonist Charles Lloyd has lent his adventurous, lyrical sound to collaborations with likes of Cannonball Adderley, Keith Jarrett and The Beach Boys. His early and highly successful experiments blending jazz and rock music charted a path that led to the electric fusion of Miles Davis and The Headhunters, while his exploration of spirituality and transcendental meditation added a new depth to his sound.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott And La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

programme.title: M.Eilertsen Trio And Trio Mediaeval - November Music
programme.desc: The annual international festival November Music was first held in 1993. Since then, the festival has been promoting contemporary music across various locations in the Netherlands city ‘s-Hertogenbosch. Its 2018 edition included jazz, avant-garde, world and electronic music, sound installations, modern opera and theatre, as well as various interdisciplinary performances.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Bertus Borgers And The Young Retro's
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan Live in '58 And 64: The Divine One
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 And 64 features the ‘Divine One’ in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as ‘Lover Man’, ‘Misty’ and ‘I Got Rhythm’ and soaring on popular showtunes such as ‘Over The Rainbow’ and ‘Maria’. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: Love X Love
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: TorTube: Humphrey's Smile
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024 interview - Julia Kadel
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.title: Manu Katché - The scOpe
programme.desc: Manu Katché is one of France's most famous jazz drummers, who originally studied piano at the Conservatory in Paris before he switched to percussion. He presented his tenth album, “The scOpe”, which incorporates elements of jazz, rock, and world music, at the 2020 edition of Festival Jazz au Sommet in France.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Trio Chemirani: Dawâr
programme.desc: The veritable tombak virtuosos of Trio Chemirani, consisting of Chemirani Senior and Juniors, enrapture the Festival de Saintes. The tombak is a Persian percussion instrument, but its rhythms are universal. The Trio Chemirani’s music is accessible to all and will certainly resound with each listener. The members of the trio, Djamchid Chemirani (born in Teheran in 1942) and his two sons and pupils Keyvan and Bijan, are living in France.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel meets Peter Beets Trio
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Charles Mingus And Eric Dolphy live in Liège
programme.desc: Charles Mingus showcases an exceptional concert performed in April 1965 featuring his most celebrated lineup: Jaki Byard (piano), Dannie Richmond (drums), Johnny Coles (trumpet), Clifford Jordan (tenor sax) and the great Eric Dolphy (alto sax, flute and bass clarinet).

programme.title: Jacques Loussier in Leipzig: Play Bach and More
programme.desc: In 1959, Jacques Loussier hit upon the idea that was to make his international reputation, by combining his interest in jazz with his love of J.S. Bach. Only a pianist with such an exceptional classical technique and deft improvisatory skill could have nurtured such a vision. He founded the Play Bach Trio, which used Bach's compositions as the basis for jazz improvisation. The trio immediately caught the public imagination.

programme.title: Sia - Live at The Metro Theatre
programme.desc: The Australian-born singer-songwriter Sia Kate Isobelle Furler, simply known as Sia, is one of the most unique artists in today's popular music scene. However, her path to stardom has been nothing but rocky. Only after numerous musical experimentations, where the singer tried to establish herself in her home country as well as United Kingdom, Sia finally blossomed in United States around the second decade of the 21st century.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Kurt Elling
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: A Quick Sketch
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sunshine (I Can Fly)
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound.

programme.title: Saluzzi, Mariano And Dauner live in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Dino Saluzzi, one of Argentina's tango music masters, has been building his legacy since the mid-1980s. His accordion-like bandoneon defines Argentina's tango music. Saluzzi has explored many paths—paths along which he has rarely travelled more than once, despite some common threads.

programme.title: Georgie Fame And the Blue Flames
programme.desc: Georgie Fame, known for 'Yeh, Yeh' and 'The Ballad of Bonnie and Clyde' makes a triumphant comeback with The Blue Flames. Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames was a popular band in the UK in the '60s, celebrated for its RAndB, soul, jazz, ska, and pop sounds. The training was largely inspired by ska, a popular musical style in Jamaican cafes in London at the time.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: B.B. King: The King of the Blues in Stuttgart
programme.desc: This uptempo, funky performance proves that B.B. King, one of the Masters of the Blues Guitar has still got it. The band features some of today's best blues musicians playing all of B.B. King's classic songs.

programme.title: Jungle By Night - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned bands. In 2019, one of them is the Amsterdam-based Dutch instrumental collective Jungle by Night. The band plays a mix of various styles, inspired by funk, jazz, dub, rock, and others. The ensemble made its debut in 2010 and has played at numerous festivals.

programme.title: STUFF. live at BIRD Rotterdam
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Medley
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa’: a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo’.

programme.title: Quartet No. 2 Part 2
programme.desc: Many of pianist Chick Corea’s compositions have become jazz standards. As a member of Miles Davis' band in the late 1960s, he participated in the birth of the electric jazz fusion movement. In the 1970s, Corea founded the legendary jazz fusion group Return to Forever. Along with Herbie Hancock, McCoy Tyner and Keith Jarrett, Corea is one of the biggest modern jazz pianists.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Count Basie - North Sea Jazz Part II
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Mike Stern And Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat And Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis’ comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: De Beren Gieren
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Lucky Peterson - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Ogloc 5tetes
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Lotus
programme.desc: Recorded in 1971 in Paris, France, Brazilian, classically trained bossa nova guitarist Baden Powell and his quartet play Pai, Lotus (written by Baden Powell), Tristeza (by Haroldo Lobo/Niltinho), Round Midnight (by Thelonious Monk), Nega do cabelo duro (by David Nasser/Rubens Soares), and Aos pes da cruz (by Zé da Zilda/Marino Pinto).

programme.title: Poinciana
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of Django, the Parisian New Morning Club pays tribute to the legendary guitarist Django Reinhardt. The program showcases the magic of Reinhardt’s compositions, as well as the virtuosity of one of his most famous heirs: Stochelo Rosenberg. With unbridled passion and enthusiasm, Rosenberg interprets the music that marked French musical heritage: gypsy jazz.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: The Art of Duo
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: Crossroads: From Blues to Bossa
programme.desc: A two-part documentary, moderated by Dee Dee Bridgewater. Part 1: From Blues to Bossa On the search for the roots and origins of Jazz, we journey into the European and African music traditions and discover the cultural heritages of Jazz from Rio to New Orleans.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko And Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: Portrait: Urgent Detergent
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Face au Public: Chuck Berry
programme.desc: No early breakthrough rock And roll artist is more important to the development of the genre than Chuck Berry (1926-2017). Influenced by jazz and rhythm and blues, he was rock And roll's greatest songwriter, the main shaper of its instrumental voice, one of its greatest guitarists, and one of its greatest performers.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Moonlight Benjamin - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Oum - Music Meeting Festival 2018
programme.desc: Oum El Ghait Benessahraoui, who is better known as Oum, gives a unique glance at ethnic Morrocan musical esthetics. The singer-songwriter is considered to be the ambassador of Morrocan culture, too. Deeply influenced by gospel, jazz, soul and RAndB genres, today Oum mixes more and more African music genres, such as Sufi, Hassani, or Afrobeat.

programme.title: Long Tall Dex: Dexter Gordon Live in '63 And '64
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 And '64 features three concerts filmed in 1963 and 1964 in Holland, Switzerland and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. Filmed while Dexter was living in Europe, these shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano) and jazz classics ‘Blues Walk’, ‘A Night In Tunisia’, ‘Body And Soul’ and others.

programme.title: The Hammond© Sessions: Sven Figee
programme.desc: The Dutch Hammond organ player Rob Mostert develops, in cooperation with DJAZZ, the programme ‘Mostert Meets’. In this series, the Hammond B3 organ takes centre stage. Rob Mostert invites the world’s finest jazz musicians for a musical collaboration, in which the Hammond Organ plays a major role.

programme.title: Louis 'Satchmo' Armstrong and His All Stars
programme.desc: Louis Armstrong: Live in '59 is one of the only known complete Armstrong concerts from the 1950s to be captured on film. This 55-minute set, filmed in Belgium in 1959, features many of Satchmo’s greatest songs including ‘Mack The Knife’, ‘When It’s Sleepy Time Down South’ and ‘Stompin’ At The Savoy,’ backed by his stellar band the All-Stars, featuring Trummy Young, Peanuts Hucko, Billy Kyle, Danny Barcelona and Mort Herbert.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: WCCB: Dina Thorslund vs. Seren Cetin T2025 - Ep. 525
programme.desc: WBC And WBO Women's Bantamweight World Champion Dina Thorslund puts her titles and undefeated record on the line in front of her hometown fans at the Royal Arena in Copenhagen, Denmark, taking on top contender and undefeated challenger Seren Cetin of Turkey. Thorslund has held World Championship gold for over five years, including seven defenses of the WBO World Title before adding the WBC Championship in September.

programme.title: Judo for the World T1 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best Judo from the Abu Dhabi Grand Slam on world Judo day, we speak to double world champion Mayra Aguiar about the unity of the Brazilian judo team, and watch as two world champions battle for gold in the -57kg division.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 47
programme.desc: This episode features a super middleweight brawl between top contenders Adonis Stevenson and Jesus Gonzales that includes a Knockout of the Year candidate, as well as kickboxing, sumo, arm wrestling and more!.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 51
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is a battle of multiple-weight world champions, as Juan Manuel Marquez challenges Marco Antonio Barrera for the WBC super featherweight title.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T25 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. Show 1 features Hakuho, Endo, Okinoumi and Yutakayamai from the Osaka Prefectural Gymnasium, in Osaka, Japan. .

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior T7 - Ep. 11

programme.title: MEGA Fights T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features a battle of unbeaten junior welterweights to unify the WBC and WBO world titles as Timothy Bradley, aka 'Desert Storm', (26-0, 11 KOs) faces Devon Alexander 'The Great' (21-1, 13 KOs).

programme.title: Judo for the World T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode, we see the best of the Judo Grand Slam from Paris as some of the 2016 Olympics' finest athletes battle for their shot at glory.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Wide World Of Fights includes all styles of fighting from around the world in one show! This episode features the first encounter between Paul Williams and Sergio Martinez, one that ends in a controversial majority decision, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is then-undefeated Adrien Broner taking on Jason Litzau in a fight that ends with a first-round TKO. Also on the card, action from light welterweight champ Amir Khan.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T27 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 1 from Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan features Shodai, Daieisho, Onosho and Takanosho.

programme.title: Fight Quest T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Episode 1: Philippines - Hosts Jimmy Smith and Doug Anderson learn the Fight Discipline of Kali - one of the deadliest, most ancient fighting systems on earth, and the Martial Art of Knives and Sticks with Masters Cristino Vasquez and Leo T. Gaje Jr.

programme.title: FIGHT SPORTS MMA T1 - Ep. 104
programme.desc: This episode features coverage of mixed martial arts headlined by a middleweight title fight between JP Kruger and Yannick Bahati. Bonus coverage includes Mark Kamba vs. Mzwandile Hlongwa and Abdul Hassan vs. JP Buys, all from South Africa.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 115
programme.desc: Consuelo aconselha Misael a seguir a vida. Paulinho coloca um rastreador no carro de Edilberto. Samira e Edilberto discutem. Juquinha se surpreende ao ver Bagdá chegando à casa de Maggye. Ferette demonstra falta de paciência com Arminda. Leonardo pede ajuda a Zenilda. Raul e Joélly deixam Gerluce e Lígia estarrecidas ao contar sobre o acordo com Samira.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 116
programme.desc: Joélly pede ajuda a Gerluce para trazer a filha de volta. Paulinho avisa que Raul pode ter de responder pelo crime na Justiça. Samira avisa a Edilberto que deixará o Brasil por um tempo. Juquinha mostra a Paulinho a foto da máscara de Clóvis, igual à usada pelos ladrões que levaram As Três Graças. Jairo avisa que o Juiz autorizou a prisão de Samira. Ferette confronta Samira.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 117
programme.desc: Ferette aconselha Samira a deixar o país. Angélico registra quando Viviane afirma que não quer mais saber de Leonardo. Jairo orienta Paulinho a tomar cuidado com Ferette. Ferette manda Vicente tirar a vida de Paulinho. Raul pede ajuda ao pastor Albérico. Arminda encontra o passaporte europeu de Samira, e fica à espera da mulher pronta para matá-la.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 118
programme.desc: Samira pede para Raul encontrá-la no aeroporto, e ameaça Joélly. Gerluce avisa a Paulinho que Samira conseguiu fugir do país. Kasper pede ajuda a Stephane para obter As Três Graças. Zenilda orienta Rogério e sua equipe a fazer a denúncia anônima da Casa da Farinha.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 119
programme.desc: Viviane recebe flores de um admirador anônimo, e depois descobre que foi Angélico. Luciano grava um vídeo de Consuelo conversando com Viviane e envia para Macedo. Stephane comunica a Bagdá que Kasper quer fazer uma exposição com as obras do líder da Chacrinha, em troca de um favor. Bagdá apavora Joaquim e Misael ao confrontá-los sobre As Três Graças.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 120
programme.desc: Lucélia não conta a João Rubens que descobriu que As Três Graças original está no ferro-velho. Gerluce comenta com Rogério que teme que Paulinho possa ter perdido a confiança nela. Paulinho, Jairo e Juquinha não encontram vestígios de fabricação de remédios no endereço que seria a Casa de Farinha. Joaquim e Misael contam para Gerluce, Viviane e Júnior que Bagdá descobriu sobre As Três Graças.

programme.title: Explode Coração - Ep. 144
programme.desc: Júlio decide deixar a mansão. Vera desiste de implicar com Júlio ao ver o estado do ex-marido. Alícia choca Serginho com notícia. Igor se oferece para ajudar Edu.

programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall. The show presents this iconic artist working at the peak of his artistic and creative powers in an unusually intimate setting. The 20-song, 90-minute set list was drawn from his legendary career and includes several songs that haven't been performed live in many years.
